scope.geometry: Project a query point to the closest point on the full untrimmed ellipse locus described by one decoded DRW_AcisEdge
scope.parameterization: Geometric locus defined by the decoded center, normal, major axis, and positive minor-to-major ratio; projection does not publish or infer a native ACIS parameter
scope.frame_policy: Normalize a temporary normal, validate the major-axis normal residual against a finite nonnegative caller-supplied dimensionless tolerance, and remove only a tolerated residual
scope.numeric_policy: Scale ellipse axes and query coordinates, solve the monotone Lagrange-multiplier equation with bounded bisection, validate the resulting ellipse constraint, and combine output coordinates with scaled arithmetic
scope.ambiguity_policy: Refuse atomically when the in-plane closest point is nonunique, including the medial-axis segment of a noncircular ellipse and the center of a circle
scope.refusal_policy: Unsupported curve type, malformed/nonfinite input, degenerate or numerically unresolved axes, out-of-tolerance frame, unrepresentable query offset/output, or nonunique closest point returns false without modifying the output
non_claims: native ACIS parameter direction or edge parameter range
finite edge trim, loop, or pcurve evaluation
native CAD or independent-kernel semantic qualification
